request.prompt:
A round carbon-steel wok seen from a high three-quarter angle, filling most of the page, holding a single serving of stir-fry at the exact moment the holy basil is added. In the wok is coarsely minced browned pork, glistening with a little dark savoury sauce, mixed through with broken pieces of pounded red and green chilli and flattened crushed garlic. Dropped on top is a loose handful of fresh holy basil: whole bright-green leaves, broadly elliptical with softly toothed edges and a lightly hairy surface, still crisp, flat and fresh, sitting on the surface of the hot food and not yet wilted or darkened into it. A few of the leaves rest slightly apart on the meat. Only a thin wisp of steam rises. The dark, seasoned wok wall curves up around the food, and the base of one handle shows at the edge, the whole scene rendered in a few flat tonal steps.

Detailed botanical-plate illustration in ink and gouache. Fine brown-black ink linework with varied line weight: heavier outer contours, hair-thin interior veins. Opaque matte gouache colour in two to three flat tonal steps with slight visible brush texture; no smooth 3D gradients, no photographic rendering, no glossy highlights. Plain warm cream paper background, completely empty, with only a faint soft contact shadow under the subject. Soft even light from the upper left. Scientific-plate accuracy: every vein, hair, tooth and node is drawn deliberately and legibly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no captions, no arrows, no borders, no watermark, no signature, no hands, no people.
